EPISODE_NARRATIVE: A cold front moved through southern New England during the early evening triggering a few severe thunderstorms in northern Massachusetts.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: In Westport, Cheryl's Way was flooded with debris and rocks in the road. Report relayed by amateur radio.
